name: Ashtanga Yoga Center Utrecht
reason: Too thin: its own site (aycutrecht.com, a WordPress.com site; robots.txt allows us) is a one-teacher Mysore programme (Megan Riley, certified by Sharath Jois) held inside another studio's building (Yoga Moves Fly, Croeselaan 209) with a Saturday led class elsewhere. The only priced item is the class-pass page (/rates/); the other pages are practical how-to-start notes, with no workshops, trainings, retreats or real free resources. Email yoga.megan@gmail.com is published. Possible future listing: Megan Riley (as an individual teacher).
